messages:
kai: Heads-up — PR #6124 is ready to merge. Changes: lower KV cache LRU threshold, add eviction jitter, small allocator tweak. Affects runtime allocator + may change observed p95. Planning merge window Tue 10:00 PST unless objections. Need: runtime + infra + security signoffs. cc @jess @mike @sara
jess: looking now, will run local perf smoke and unit tests. expect results in ~30m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
mike: pinging infra for KMS access path + rolling restart behavior. @eva can infra ops comment on rollout safety?
eva: infra: KV lease change might require staged rollout. suggest canary at 10% for 2h, monitor eviction_rate and mem_pressure. I can own canary if you want.
sara: security: quick read — KMS calls unchanged, but we need an audit entry for eviction-triggered logs. add a short changelog note and I'll clear. low risk otherwise.
kai: thanks — adding changelog line and small test harness for canary. snippet:
```
# canary rollout plan
./deploy --pr 6124 --percent 10 --duration 2h --metrics eviction_rate,mem_pressure
```
jess: perf smoke shows +3% p95 on short seqs, but steady. pushing results to the PR CI comments.
mike: infra note: ensure kube rolling strategy set to maxUnavailable=1 for this deploy, otherwise KV shards may evict badly. I'll add env var in the helm override.
kai: added helm override commit + changelog. requesting lgtm from runtime + infra + sec. If no blockers we'll merge Tue 10:00 PST. @deploy-bot please queue for that slot.
deploy-bot: scheduled PR #6124 for 2028-03-21T10:00:00-08:00 in merge queue. will abort if any blocking labels added.
sara: cleared after changelog update. :white_check_mark:
jess: runtime lgtm from me, will handle rollback play if we see >10% eviction surge.
eva: infra lgtm, canary owner assigned (eva). monitor SLOs and ping if anything odd.
kai: awesome — thanks all. I'll annotate runbook and set alert thresholds. If anyone wants earlier eyes happy to pair.
